endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: mo_springfield_parkboard_lake_springfield_boathouse_20260919 springfield-park-board-lake-springfield-boathouse: The Springfield-Greene County Park Board identifies Lake Springfield Boathouse as a public park shoreline facility with boat rentals, accessible parking, and James River Water Trail use. The route source records the Park Board map/KML placemark at the stored coordinate and distinguishes the Boathouse from the separate boat launch. Retain the point as the boathouse shoreline/take-out facility anchor; the 755-foot named-flowline offset is expected because the finish is in Lake Springfield rather than on the upstream James River flowline.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (mo_springfield_parkboard_lake_springfield_boathouse_20260919 springfield-park-board-lake-springfield-boathouse) on James River / Lake Springfield; access is conditional (Confirm current Park Board hours, shoreline landing, parking, and any event or rental restrictions at arrival; use the marked Boathouse shoreline facility and do not substitute the separate boat launch without route review.), not unrestricted public access.
